fact: IIDIA and ASIN launched a Regional Innovation and Digital Technology Lab in Cotonou to develop the first voice-to-voice AI model in the Fon language, with a functional prototype due within 9 months, trained on NVIDIA A100/H100 GPUs, with Gates Foundation support.

IIDIA and Benin's ASIN launched in Cotonou the development of a Fon-language voice-to-voice AI model, with a prototype due in nine months, trained on NVIDIA A100/H100 GPUs, supported by the Gates Foundation.
